about.body: momoko.pro is an unofficial fan site for Suō Momoko from THE IDOLM@STER MILLION LIVE! THEATER DAYS. Stable profile information is kept separate from reviewed editorial updates and clearly linked to its source.
profile.title: Who is Momoko?
profile.intro: Suō Momoko is an idol in THE IDOLM@STER MILLION LIVE! THEATER DAYS. The official profile describes her as a former child actor with a cool manner and a strong professional spirit.
policy.title: Source & Copyright Policy
policy.intro: This site's sourcing and copyright boundaries are as follows (machine config lives in config/sources.json):
policy.noCopy: We do not reproduce official images, logos, lyrics, quotes, audio, or scraped bodies — only human fact notes and links.
policy.automated: No automated fetching is active (S1–S5 automated_fetch=false); a crawler needs explicit project enablement and a robots decision for its requested path.
policy.robots: Robots separates a result class from the decision for one checked path: a 404 is unavailable with path allow under RFC 9309, not owner or project approval. Single-page human requests, crawler batches, and reuse/publication are separate access modes.
policy.aiUse: AI may assist with drafts or translation, but it cannot approve publication; every public content package requires human review.
policy.noCurrentSources: No reviewed current source package is published yet.
policy.correctionBody: Corrections and takedowns require an explicit human review record. A retracted or stale package is excluded from public output; the site does not silently replace an uncertain fact.
